exit: 0
--- stdout
CDL.Reals.PID
  P, PI, PD, and PID controller

parameters:
  controllerType : SimpleController = PI
      Type of controller
  k : Real = 1.0
      Gain of controller
      range: k >= 1e-13
  Ti : Real = 0.5
      Time constant of integrator block
      unit: s; quantity: Time
      range: Ti >= 1e-13
  Td : Real = 0.1
      Time constant of derivative block
      unit: s; quantity: Time
      range: Td >= 1e-13
  r : Real = 1.0
      Typical range of control error, used for scaling the control error
      range: r >= 1e-13
  yMax : Real = 1.0
      Upper limit of output
      range: yMin <= yMax; yMin == yMax warns
  yMin : Real = 0.0
      Lower limit of output
      range: yMin <= yMax; yMin == yMax warns
  Ni : Real = 0.9
      Ni*Ti is time constant of anti-windup compensation
      range: Ni >= 1e-13
  Nd : Real = 10.0
      The higher Nd, the more ideal the derivative block
      range: Nd >= 1e-13
  xi_start : Real = 0.0
      Initial value of integrator state
  yd_start : Real = 0.0
      Initial value of derivative output
  reverseActing : Boolean = true
      Set to true for reverse acting, or false for direct acting control action

inputs:
  u_s : Real
      Setpoint input signal
  u_m : Real
      Measurement input signal

outputs:
  y : Real
      Actuator output signal

notes:
  (none)

links:
  source at the pinned Buildings commit: https://github.com/lbl-srg/modelica-buildings/blob/a131864e4c4df22ebcd52bb8da439de0087ac365/Buildings/Controls/OBC/CDL/Reals/PID.mo
  help in the latest Buildings release (may drift from the pin): https://simulationresearch.lbl.gov/modelica/releases/latest/help/Buildings_Controls_OBC_CDL_Reals.html#Buildings.Controls.OBC.CDL.Reals.PID
